items.title: Uber (UBER) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Analysts Rework Targets
items.summary: Analysts have trimmed their fair value estimate for Uber Technologies from about US$101.24 per share to roughly US$99.16 per share, signaling a small reset in modeled upside. Many research firms are refreshing their price targets after the latest results, reflecting different views on how durable Uber’s growth and profit path may be and how current risks could influence where the stock eventually trades. items.title: Lucid Signed Up for 25,000 Bolt Robotaxis. Monday Shows What It Can Afford
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLucid reports third-quarter results after Monday’s close, with consensus revenue near $399 million, up from $337 million a year earlier. Deliveries of 3,806 missed the 4,687 estimate as Lucid cut production to 2,954 and ran down inventory under its operating reset.
